params.prompt: Prop design sheet: a small old handheld voice recorder from the 1980s, palm-sized, scuffed faded red plastic body with a silver metal speaker grille, one round button and one small slide switch, a tiny round indicator light, a small window showing a mini cassette inside, a short black wrist strap; no labels, no brand, no writing.
